title: Fantastic Multigenerational Tour!
text: Fantastic bike tour in Barcelona, our guide was knowledgeable, engaging and fun! We were a multigenerational group, the ride was easy and enjoyable for everyone, from kids to grandparents.  Highly recommend!
author: melissa5423

title: Amazing bike tour of the city
text: We had an amazing bike tour. So relaxed. Great way to see the city. Our guide was great. We had a wonderful time
author: Crystal_R

title: Bike Tour
text: We had a great time on the tour. Austen was extremely knowledgeable of the places & history. We felt very safe on our bikes & thoroughly enjoyed the route we were taken on. Highly recommend.
author: Mobile24365758010

title: Excellent bicycle tour with Jean Pierre!
text: John Pierre made our bicycle tour awesome. It’s all about the guide and their good energy and all the insightful information they tell you along the way. Very pleasant, relaxed, informative, and delightful. Thank you, Jean Pierre.
author: jimmybarcroft

title: Brilliant tour
text: Great tour and Mariana was a fantastic guide. We saw tons of stuff we would not otherwise have found, and got a great overview of the non-tourist dominated parts of the city. Mariana was really interesting and informed, and made it all lots of fun for all of us (2 x adults, 12 yo and 15 yo). She also gave us great tips for the rest of out stay. Really highly recommended.
author: matthewhD1508JA

title: Fun and informative way to see Barcelona
text: Perfect way to see Barcelona. We were in a group of 5. Comfortable bikes and a great overview of the city. Augustin was an excellent guide, friendly and knowledgeable and told us many interesting facts about the city and its history. It was at a relaxed pace and we could stop when we wanted.  100% recommend Augustin and Steel Donkeys
author: R8862OQjoh

title: Worthwhile activity in Barcelona
text: Worthwhile activity to ride around getting to know parts of the city. Our guide Bella was very knowledgeable and passionate about her guiding. Would recommend this to anyone who can ride a bike. Flat and no hills
author: JKE255103

title: Please book your bike...
text: Please book your bike tour NOW!  Bella was absolutely incredible- knowledgeable, kind, energetic, safe, and FUN!!!  Thank you, thank you!  A total highlight of our trip to Barcelona!
author: Jinger_G

title: Perfect way to see Barcelona
text: What a great time with just 7 people. Easy to get to know everyone. A perfect way to see Barcelona. If you can ride a bike, it’s SO much better than a bus tour. 100 percent recommended.
author: Safari10771263682

title: Fantastic way to get local insight and explore less touristy spots
text:
This was a wonderful tour, with the route tailored to the group. Mariana was full of life and energy, sharing stories and history of the city with passion and pride. We explored some touristy places, riding along the coast and zigzagging through the Gothic Quarter, but also some more local neighbourhoods and parks.
